ITEM 1 | Square white plate about 20 cm across used as scale; food sits in the center-left area | 0
ITEM 2 | Green zucchini-like slices with dark green skin and pale green flesh, cut into crescent wedges about 4-5 cm long, lightly charred edges, moist, sitting in the lower-left of the plate | 110
ITEM 3 | Pale yellow-tan sautéed wedges with golden browned edges and a few flecks of red pepper, about 3-4 cm pieces, slightly glossy from oil, lower center of plate | 70
ITEM 4 | Yellow squash or zucchini pieces with bright yellow skin and pale interior, small cubes about 2-3 cm, golden browned spots, lower center | 35
ITEM 5 | Red tomato wedges with glossy red flesh and seeds, about 4 cm long, slightly softened, right side of plate beside green pepper pieces | 45
ITEM 6 | Green bell pepper pieces with bright green skin, cut into chunks about 2-3 cm, slightly wilted, top center near the onion | 15
ITEM 7 | Small pale onion pieces and whole pearl-like white bulbs about 2 cm, translucent and soft, with light golden caramelized edges, top center | 25
ITEM 8 | Sautéed onion strands with light golden-brown color and soft limp texture, a thin layer spread across upper left, slightly oily sheen | 20
ITEM 9 | Chunks of cooked meat or fish with light grey-tan flesh, flaky, layered texture, some browned crust and glaze, about 4-5 cm pieces, sitting on the upper right of the plate | 90
